name: tex-word-count
description: Counts the words in a LaTeX file (ignoring commands and comments) and shows the total in the status bar.

commands.title: TeX Word Count: Show Word Count
TeX Word Count: Set Progress Marker Interval
TeX Word Count: Toggle Progress Markers
TeX Word Count: Confirm Lua Word Counts

texWordCount.countBracedArguments.description: Count the text inside command braces (for example, the title in \section{...}).

texWordCount.showCharacters.description: Also show a character count (without spaces) alongside the word count in the status bar.

texWordCount.progressMarkers.enabled.description: Show a faint marker in the editor at every milestone of the running word count.

texWordCount.progressMarkers.interval.description: Number of words between progress markers.

texWordCount.luaWarnings.description: Mark Lua blocks whose word count is missing, not confirmed or out of date. Turning this off only hides the markers, the announced words are still counted.
